title: OpenAI launches Codex Micro, a compact AI agent control keyboard #OpenAI #CodexMicro #AIhardware
description: OpenAI launched Codex Micro, a compact $230 keyboard designed to control multiple AI agents with ease. Featuring six RGB keys that indicate agent status and a rotary dial for adjusting AI reasoning depth, it streamlines managing AI workflows physically rather than digitally. Codex Micro addresses the challenges of juggling various AI processes by providing intuitive visual cues—blue for thinking, green for done, orange for waiting, and red for errors—enhancing user experience and productivity. Its joystick allows seamless switching between agents without using a mouse, resembling a mixing board but for AI control. As OpenAI’s first hardware product, Codex Micro marks a significant step toward integrating specialized physical interfaces in AI development, reflecting the growing complexity and multi-agent nature of modern AI applications. This innovation signals a new direction in AI tools, emphasizing tactile control and operational clarity. #OpenAI #CodexMicro #AIhardware #AIAgents #ArtificialIntelligence #TechInnovation #AIworkflow #OpenAIhardware #AIcontrol #AITools #FutureOfAI #AItechnology #TechTrends #AIproduct #DigitalInnovation
